description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to land parcels, Pokunuwita, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530177
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. The notices specifically deal with land title claims, cadastral maps, land parcels, and the determination of land ownership in various districts. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registration, property ownership claims, and land title settlement matters.
